hints.title: Greedy Backtracking Strategy
hints.text: Try placing numbers at each empty index starting from n down to 1 to maximize lexicographical order.

hints.title: Check Distance Constraint
hints.text: Number 1 occupies a single index, whereas number d requires index i and i + d both to be unoccupied.

hints.title: Early Termination
hints.text: Because we search values in descending order, the first valid complete sequence found is guaranteed to be optimal.

hints.title: Full Implementation

variables: n is the given integer bound
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating all permutations of length 2n - 1 explores (2n - 1)! possibilities.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Backtracking with distance pruning and descending selection finds the first valid state rapidly.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate places larger values at earliest available positions with immediate distance validation.
